title: 转述陈述、提问与回答

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

questions.prompt: The guide ____ that the room was open.
options: told to
said to that
said
telling
questions.evidence: 转述陈述时，say 后可直接接 that 从句；tell 通常先接被告知的人，再接 that 从句。不要把 tell 和 say 的宾语结构混为一谈。
questions.explanation: said 可直接接 that 从句；told 通常需要受话人，其他形式不能构成该句。

questions.prompt: The guide ____ the reporter that the room was open.
options: said
told
told to
speaking
questions.evidence: 转述陈述时，say 后可直接接 that 从句；tell 通常先接被告知的人，再接 that 从句。不要把 tell 和 say 的宾语结构混为一谈。
questions.explanation: told 后直接接受话人 the reporter；said 不能直接以人作此位置的宾语。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct report of a statement.
options: Hana said that the event was planned.
Hana told that the event was planned.
Hana said the editor that the event was planned.
Hana saying that the event was planned.
answers: Hana said that the event was planned.
questions.evidence: 转述陈述时，say 后可直接接 that 从句；tell 通常先接被告知的人，再接 that 从句。不要把 tell 和 say 的宾语结构混为一谈。
questions.explanation: said 后可接 that 从句；told 缺受话人，said 后不能这样直接接受话人。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the person receiving the message.
options: The editor told that the date was unclear.
The editor said Leena that the date was unclear.
The editor told Leena that the date was unclear.
The editor telling Leena that the date was unclear.
answers: The editor told Leena that the date was unclear.
questions.evidence: 转述陈述时，say 后可直接接 that 从句；tell 通常先接被告知的人，再接 that 从句。不要把 tell 和 say 的宾语结构混为一谈。
questions.explanation: told 后有受话人 Leena，再接 that 从句；其他选项缺宾语或谓语结构错误。

questions.prompt: Yesterday Maya said, “I am tired.” Report her past statement.
options: Maya said that she was tired.
Maya said that she are tired.
Maya said that she be tired.
Maya said that she tired was.
answers: Maya said that she was tired.
questions.evidence: 叙述已经结束的过去谈话时，转述动词用过去式，原话中的 am / is、have 和 will 常分别后移为 was、had 和 would；若内容仍然真实，也可能保留原时态。
questions.explanation: 过去叙述中 am 常后移为 was；are 与 she 不一致，be 和倒装词序也不合。

questions.prompt: Yesterday Arun said, “I will return.” Choose the backshifted report.
options: Arun said that he would returned.
Arun said that he will to return.
Arun said that he would returns.
Arun said that he would return.
answers: Arun said that he would return.
questions.evidence: 叙述已经结束的过去谈话时，转述动词用过去式，原话中的 am / is、have 和 will 常分别后移为 was、had 和 would；若内容仍然真实，也可能保留原时态。
questions.explanation: will 可后移为 would，would 后接动词原形 return；其他形式均不合结构。

questions.prompt: Yesterday the guide said, “I have finished.” Choose the backshifted report of her words.
options: The guide said that she had finish.
The guide said that she had finished.
The guide said that she have finished.
The guide said that she had finishing.
answers: The guide said that she had finished.
questions.evidence: 叙述已经结束的过去谈话时，转述动词用过去式，原话中的 am / is、have 和 will 常分别后移为 was、had 和 would；若内容仍然真实，也可能保留原时态。
questions.explanation: 转述过去谈话时 have finished 可后移为 had finished；had 后要用过去分词。

questions.prompt: A female representative said, “I am ready.” Choose a correct backshifted report of her words.
options: The representative said that she was ready.
The representative said that she were ready.
The representative said that she ready was.
The representative said that she be ready.
answers: The representative said that she was ready.
questions.evidence: 叙述已经结束的过去谈话时，转述动词用过去式，原话中的 am / is、have 和 will 常分别后移为 was、had 和 would；若内容仍然真实，也可能保留原时态。
questions.explanation: am 可后移为 was，she 使用单数形式，陈述从句保留正常语序。

questions.prompt: A visitor asked, “Is the door open?” Choose the reported question.
options: The visitor asked if was the door open.
The visitor asked that was the door open.
The visitor asked if the door was open.
The visitor asked if the door open was.
answers: The visitor asked if the door was open.
questions.evidence: 转述一般疑问句可用 asked if / whether；转述特殊疑问句保留疑问词，但从句使用主语在动词前的陈述语序，不再使用原来的倒装。
questions.explanation: 一般疑问转述用 if，后面用 the door was 的陈述语序；原问句倒装不能保留。

questions.prompt: The reporter asked, “Where is the picture?” Choose the reported question.
options: The reporter asked where was the picture.
The reporter asked if where the picture was.
The reporter asked where the picture were.
The reporter asked where the picture was.
answers: The reporter asked where the picture was.
questions.evidence: 转述一般疑问句可用 asked if / whether；转述特殊疑问句保留疑问词，但从句使用主语在动词前的陈述语序，不再使用原来的倒装。
questions.explanation: 保留疑问词 where，后接 the picture was；不再倒装，picture 为单数。

questions.prompt: The editor asked, “Did Maya agree?” Choose the reported question.
options: The editor asked whether had Maya agreed.
The editor asked whether Maya had agree.
The editor asked that did Maya agree.
The editor asked whether Maya had agreed.
answers: The editor asked whether Maya had agreed.
questions.evidence: 转述一般疑问句可用 asked if / whether；转述特殊疑问句保留疑问词，但从句使用主语在动词前的陈述语序，不再使用原来的倒装。
questions.explanation: 一般疑问可用 whether，后接 Maya had agreed；倒装和缺少过去分词都不合。

questions.prompt: The visitor asked, “When does the class start?” Choose the indirect question.
options: The visitor asked when did the class start.
The visitor asked when the class started.
The visitor asked if when the class started.
The visitor asked when the class start did.
answers: The visitor asked when the class started.
questions.evidence: 转述一般疑问句可用 asked if / whether；转述特殊疑问句保留疑问词，但从句使用主语在动词前的陈述语序，不再使用原来的倒装。
questions.explanation: when 后用陈述语序 the class started；不能再加 did 倒装或同时加 if。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations; the last four questions transfer the rule to new situations.
passage:
1. 转述陈述时，say 后可直接接 that 从句；tell 通常先接被告知的人，再接 that 从句。不要把 tell 和 say 的宾语结构混为一谈。
例句：The editor said that the date was uncertain. The visitor told Hana that she had a question.

2. 叙述已经结束的过去谈话时，转述动词用过去式，原话中的 am / is、have 和 will 常分别后移为 was、had 和 would；若内容仍然真实，也可能保留原时态。
例句：She said that the hall was ready. He said that he would return.

3. 转述一般疑问句可用 asked if / whether；转述特殊疑问句保留疑问词，但从句使用主语在动词前的陈述语序，不再使用原来的倒装。
例句：They asked if the room was open. She asked where the map was.
